text:
maya: quick heads-up — i sketched a launch narrative for the latency vs cost benchmark. want a short thread to align on 3 assets: a hero chart, a 3-panel explainer, and webinar hooks.

leo: nice. can you call out the customer POV we want to hit? e.g., 'predictable unit economics' vs 'peak throughput wins'.

maya: yes — primary is predictable unit economics for product teams; secondary is 'how to trade latency for $/token' for infra/platform audiences.

ada: re: numbers — pulled a few slices from last run. putting rough CSV below for charting. can someone confirm axis choices?

ada: ```
model,median_latency_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens
redwood-8k,45,0.06
redwood-13b,120,0.08
gptx-small,200,0.12
open-13b-q4,95,0.05
```

rachel: for the hero, i want a scatter with latency on x (ms) and cost on y ($/1k). color by recommended use-case (interactive vs batch). add dotted lines for our SLA sweet spot.

sam: webinar idea — 20m demo + 15m panel. title: "Serving economics: real tradeoffs between latency, cost, and UX". CTA: signup for Dedicated trial + benchmark kit.

leo: messaging test — two variants: 1) "Lower cost at scale without latency surprises" 2) "Consistent latency for mission-critical features". we A/B in capture form and follow-up email.

maya: love both. key is to tie each to an example slice — e.g., chat vs document search vs reranking.

ada: quick stats to support claims: cache hit improvements reduce token cost by ~25% on doc-search workload; batching cuts cost per token by ~18% at 200 qps.

rachel: design asks: can we get a short copy block for each slice (one sentence each) + screenshot of the chat demo? copy examples: 
- chat: "Instant replies, sub-100ms median for 8k context"
- search: "Cheap reranks at scale, lower per-query spend"
- rerank: "Deterministic tail latency for SLAs"

maya: ada/leo — can you both agree on the final numbers to lock the hero chart? need them by EOD today so design can mock.

leo: i can confirm model points and SLA bands by 4pm PST.

ada: i'll re-run the slice with prefix-caching toggles and post final CSV by 3:30.

rachel: will start comps at 5pm and iterate tomorrow morning.

sam: inbound flow — suggest we route webinar signups with >50 seats interest to AE queue, otherwise nurture with benchmark kit. will prepare routing rules.

maya: perfect. action items: ada final CSV, leo confirm axis & SLA lines, rachel first comps, sam routing rules. i'll draft tweet + announcement copy once hero chart lands.

deploy-bot: benchmark-run-5267 completed. artifacts uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-bench/5267/ (link) :white_check_mark:

maya: great — thanks all. quick async check-in only. ping if you need more context. :rocket:
